scope: Posthoc scientific review of the two finalized saved IK-driven native runs. No simulation, inference, detector rerun, numerical code change, input mutation or replacement of frozen windows.

conclusion.main_finding: With the same prescribed V26 controller/configuration and the same predeclared selection rule, the three observed post-startup nominal cycles under-load measured left GRF on AB06 (impulse -13.8021%) and over-load it on AB07 (+39.9885%). AB07 over-loading appears in each selected cycle (+31.6951% to +45.0621%) and is also present in startup; exclusion of startup does not remove it.
conclusion.timing_finding: The binary geometry-FSM onset is earlier than measured 20 N GRF HS and later than measured TO for both subjects. Mean HS/TO biases are -34.250/+98.653 ms on AB06 and -94.464/+122.130 ms on AB07. Each primary onset channel matches 4/4 HS and 3/3 TO under inherited diagnostic tolerances, with no extra/missing binary onset; these are diagnostic comparisons, not acceptance.
conclusion.force_waveform_finding: AB06 has lower normalized force error and higher waveform correlation (RMS 0.15614 BW; correlation 0.94377) than AB07 (0.37832 BW; 0.87971). Absolute peak force is similar, but modeled body mass differs: primary peak is 1.19506 BW on AB06 and 1.60309 BW on AB07.
conclusion.runtime_exception_finding: AB06 physical integration reaches the requested 9 s horizon and preserves 17 finite 9000-row output tables; its last binary transport callback raises before returning observation/reward/event/termination and before trace row900 is written. Receipt remains failed with 899 returned boundaries. Its frozen three primary cycles, including all matched closing events, precede this final callback and are fully observed. The missing final payload is not reconstructed.
conclusion.causal_scope: No learned policy is present in either run. The paired design supports a difference between the two tested subject model/IK/measured-right-loading bundles under the frozen common controller/contact profiles. It does not isolate anatomical geometry, IK, measured right loading, mass, registration or a particular contact-profile parameter as the unique cause.

methodology.primary: Exactly three preselected nominal complete cycles after one excluded nominal startup cycle for each subject; cycle boundaries come from measured GRF, never simulated FSM event counts.
methodology.acquisition: Saved native 1 ms STO grids, checked against captured integration_dt. Exact nominal endpoints are interpolated inside observed support, allowing 10 ns timestamp coincidence for STO 8-decimal serialization only; no extrapolation beyond that declared rounding allowance.
methodology.force_normalization: Fy/BW with frozen subject model mass times9.80665. Compare simulation/measurement impulse ratio per-cycle and ratio of summed impulses; BW normalization is postprocessing only.
methodology.phase_waveform_csv: 1001 points per nominal cycle, phase0..1, derived from native samples for shape visualization only; physical impulse/RMS metrics retain native 1 ms grids.
methodology.event_semantics: Saved binary geometryFSM onset, confirmed and delivered versus measured GRF events are separate from retained actor events and raw vertical-force 20 N crossings. Missing and extra events are retained.
methodology.tolerance_scope: Inherited diagnostic references, not newly adopted subject acceptance gates.
methodology.interruptions: Frozen requested duration and cycle boundaries remain unchanged. Any unavailable full primary cycle is reported unavailable and the3-cycle aggregate is withheld; observed last sample never becomes a replacement nominal end.

SEA_XML_semantic_comparison.scope: Only SEA properties explicitly captured in the frozen selection. This numerical text-serialization comparison is not a subject gait gate; complete runtime SEA/PI equations are checked by the separate native numerical audit.

configuration.allowed_subject_changes: subject model/anatomy/mass, IK, measured GRF including right applied GRF, subject reserve definitions, source time ranges, setup/output paths and reset offsets chosen by frozen rule

design_and_comparability.force_sides: Left GRF is generated dynamically by online contact in both runs and compared with measured left GRF. Right measured GRF is applied as subject-specific external loading. Prescribed IK supplies prosthetic references and biological tracking; it does not replace the dynamically generated left GRF with measured force.

interpretation_limits: Successful physical coverage and coherent SEA equations are distinct from successful end-to-end policy-boundary transport. AB06 endpoint observation/reward/event/FSM completion remains unqualified despite full physical horizon coverage.

The final AB06 guard miss is quantified by the numerical audit: last segment duration differs from ten 1 ms samples by -1.13175268 ps; sample-count residual 1.13175247e-9 exceeds existing 1e-9 tolerance. This review neither changes that guard nor reruns the episode.

Onset, confirmed and delivered timestamps have different meanings and inherited matching tolerances. Confirmed/delivered channels contain missed/extra matches and remain explicit in the comparison JSON; 4/4 onset matching is not equivalent to confirmed/delivered timing fidelity.

Raw simulated Fy crossings at 20 N are a separate channel from geometry-FSM onset. Primary raw force matching retains two extra HS and two extra TO on AB06 and four extra HS and four extra TO on AB07. Their mean matched timing bias must not be substituted for binary geometry timing or used to hide extra crossings.
Initial reset occurs at nominal measured HS and initializes stance; the absent streamed reset HS is explicitly recorded in startup matching and is not counted as a missed primary transition.
Actual-minus-served prosthetic-reference RMS is about 0.45 to 0.53 degrees, while raw-IK RMS differs more; following the served reference does not prove faithful reproduction of measured loading.

Primary penetration maxima are about 22.97 mm on AB06 and 21.36 mm on AB07. All saved episode samples remain below the inherited 28 mm hard reference, but exceeding or remaining below diagnostic penetration references does not itself establish gait validity or identify the cause of load bias.

Both numerical audits retain the legacy MTP-tracking failure (approximately 14.00 degrees RMS AB06 and 10.83 degrees AB07 against zero reference), separate from SEA numerical validity and paired force conclusions. Recruitment/reserve and cascade diagnostics remain available in the numerical audits.

Selection was frozen before simulation and is unchanged. Primary impulse uses the three exact nominal boundaries and native 1 ms acquisition, with only the documented 10 ns source timestamp serialization allowance; no artificial phase/delay alignment was applied to numerical metrics.
The three primary cycle durations are subject-specific measured gait periods; matching cycle count and phase rule does not mean matching raw timestamps or equal physical duration.
During-run and post-run plugin binary hashes agree. Their first acquisition was during integration, not a pre-launch binary hash attestation or inspection of loaded in-memory bytes.
